traits.habitat_notes: Woods, hammocks, thickets, shell ridges and middens, roadsides and disturbed ground, 0-1700 m, from the southern United States through Mexico, the West Indies and Central America to South America; naturalised and weedy in tropical Asia, Africa, Australia and the Pacific; shade tolerant and tolerant of salt spray.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form chosen from the plant's habit: a soft herb, woody at the base, with forking stems, thin ovate leaves and slender racemes of tiny pink-white flowers and scarlet berries.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species.

allometry.note: 0.7 m tall at 2 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a soft herb, woody at the base, with forking stems, thin ovate leaves and slender racemes of tiny pink-white flowers and scarlet berries.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): herbs or subshrubs, woody at base; German Wikipedia: perennial herb to subshrub, the stem woody at its base.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): perennial.

traits.leaf_habit.note: English Wikipedia, 'Rivina humilis' (read 2026-10-19, lower trust): 'this evergreen perennial'. German Wikipedia instead calls it deciduous (laubwerfend); the evergreen reading is kept for a plant of frost-free warm regions that flowers all year (FNA).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): plants 30-100 cm tall; FNA 0.4-2 m.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): plants 0.4-2 m.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): plants erect, straggling, or vinelike; German Wikipedia: stem upright on its own or clambering.

traits.stem_cross_section.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): stems angulate; German Wikipedia: ribbed (gerippt).

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): ± glabrous or densely pubescent; Flora of China: branches spreading, pubescent when young.

traits.stem_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: green stems; no source read names a colour.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): leaves alternate.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: alternate leaves in a spiral, as in Phytolaccaceae generally; no source read says.

traits.leaf_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): leaf blade.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Phytolaccaceae (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=10687, read 2026-10-19): leaves simple.

traits.leaf_venation.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Phytolaccaceae (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=10687, read 2026-10-19): blade pinnately veined.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): blade lanceolate, elliptic, or oblong to deltate or ovate; Flora of China: ovate or ovate-lanceolate, genus: ovate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): apex acuminate or acute to obtuse or emarginate; Flora of China: long acuminate.

traits.leaf_base_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): base cuneate or rounded to truncate or cordate (cordate is not a base state here); Flora of China: attenuate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): margin slightly serrulate; FNA family: margins entire, often undulate. Entire usual, finely serrate sometimes.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): pubescent beneath along the midvein, glabrous above; FNA: plants ± glabrous or densely pubescent.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): blade 4-12 cm; FNA: to 15 cm; German Wikipedia 2.5-15 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): blade 1.5-4 cm wide; FNA to 9 cm; German Wikipedia 1.5-9 cm. Upper typical 5 cm is our midpoint between them.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): petiole 1-3.5 cm, pubescent; FNA 1-11 cm.

traits.leaf_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: plain mid-green, rather thin leaves; no source read names a colour.

traits.stipules.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Phytolaccaceae (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=10687, read 2026-10-19): stipules minute or absent; none described for Rivina.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): racemes.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): racemes 4-15 cm; Flora of China 4-10 cm including the peduncle.

traits.peduncle_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): peduncle 1-5 cm.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): racemes erect or curved, slender.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: German Wikipedia, 'Rivina humilis' (read 2026-10-19 through the GBIF species API descriptions, dataset 'German Wikipedia - Species Pages', as de.wikipedia.org itself was blocked; lower trust; our translation): racemes of five to fifty flowers; FNA genus 5-50-flowered.

traits.flowering_position.note: German Wikipedia, 'Rivina humilis' (read 2026-10-19 through the GBIF species API descriptions, dataset 'German Wikipedia - Species Pages', as de.wikipedia.org itself was blocked; lower trust; our translation): racemes terminal or lateral (end- oder seitenständig).

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): pedicel 2-8 mm; German Wikipedia: 2 mm at flowering, lengthening to 8 mm in fruit.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: four spreading tepals 1.5-3.5 mm long make a flower about 4-6 mm across.

traits.perianth.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): sepals 4, no petals: one whorl.

traits.perianth_parts.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): sepals 4.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): sepals 4, stamens 4.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): sepals 1.5-3.5 mm; Flora of China tepals 2-2.5 mm, 3-3.5 mm in fruit.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): sepals white or green to pink or purplish; Flora of China: white or pink; German Wikipedia: green in bud, turning white and pink during flowering. White flushed pink; sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.bud_colour.note: German Wikipedia, 'Rivina humilis' (read 2026-10-19 through the GBIF species API descriptions, dataset 'German Wikipedia - Species Pages', as de.wikipedia.org itself was blocked; lower trust; our translation): tepals green in the bud; sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): stamens 4.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): stamens shorter than and alternate with the tepals.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): carpel 1; style present, often curved (species); stigma capitate.

traits.sexual_system.note: German Wikipedia, 'Rivina humilis' (read 2026-10-19 through the GBIF species API descriptions, dataset 'German Wikipedia - Species Pages', as de.wikipedia.org itself was blocked; lower trust; our translation): flowers bisexual (zwittrig).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: German Wikipedia, 'Rivina humilis' (read 2026-10-19 through the GBIF species API descriptions, dataset 'German Wikipedia - Species Pages', as de.wikipedia.org itself was blocked; lower trust; our translation): flowers radially symmetric and four-parted.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=128629, read 2026-10-19): fruits berries.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): berry globose or pyriform; FNA genus: subglobose.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): berries 2.5-5 mm diam; Flora of China 3-4 mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: English Wikipedia, 'Rivina humilis' (read 2026-10-19, lower trust): glossy, bright red berry; FNA genus: red to orange or yellow. sRGB by eye for the word.

traits.fruit_colour_ripening.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: berries green before they colour, as in most fleshy fruits; no source read says.

traits.fruits_per_inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: about as many berries as flowers (5-50); FNA says the plant is more attractive in fruit than in flower.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=2 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): tepals persistent, 3-3.5 mm in fruit, green, reflexed.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): flowering year-round.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: flowers all year (FNA), so ripe berries are on the plant all year; no source states fruiting separately.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): 0-1700 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): 0-1700 m.

traits.light.note: English Wikipedia, 'Rivina humilis' (read 2026-10-19, lower trust): requires less than partial sun and tolerates full shade; valued as a shade-tolerant groundcover.

traits.moisture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): woods, hammocks, thickets: moderately moist habitats (our reading).

traits.soil_texture.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: woodland and disturbed soils, shell ridges (calcareous sand); no source read names a texture.

traits.habitat_notes.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Rivina humilis (eFloras flora_id=1 taxon_id=220011674, read 2026-10-19): woods, hammocks, thickets, shell ridges, roadsides, disturbed areas, 0-1700 m; Wikipedia: tolerant of salt spray and saline soils, naturalised widely in the tropics.

traits.shoot_leaves.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: a stem 0.3-1 m with alternate leaves several cm apart.

traits.flowering_branches.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: FNA: racemes terminal and from the upper axils.
